records.subject: You're in -- let's get Ridge Labs set up
records.body:
Hi Jules,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 0 (2026-06-13) but nothing since; 6 days silent, no reply to onboarding email [email:d7f5564a], no invite sent, no tickets. Starter, solo user with no engagement signal and 8 days left makes unaided key milestone unlikely though not impossible given early project creation.

draft.subject: A quick next step for Ridge Labs
draft.body:
Hi Jules,

Checking in now that your first project is up in Wrenfield. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding the work you're tracking there is usually the quickest way to see whether it fits how Ridge Labs runs.

It also tends to click faster with a second person in the account 	y	â€” a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm glad to walk through your first setup with you and answer anything that's in the way.

Best,
Nadia
